seo_title: Google Business Profile Optimisation Delhi: 2026 Checklist
description: Google Business Profile optimisation for Delhi businesses: a step-by-step checklist to rank in the map pack and get more calls, directions and WhatsApp chats.
headline: Google Business Profile optimisation in Delhi: a checklist to rank in the map pack
card_title: Google Business Profile optimisation in Delhi
card_text: Name, categories, pin, photos, reviews, WhatsApp and citations: the checklist to get your Delhi business into the map pack.
intro:
When someone in Delhi types "dentist near me", "coaching centre in Dwarka" or "cake shop Rajouri Garden", Google usually shows a map with three businesses above the regular website results. That box is the map pack, and the listings in it come from Google Business Profile. Good Google Business Profile optimisation in Delhi is often the cheapest way for a local business to get more calls, direction requests and walk-ins.

Most checklists online are written for the US and stop at "add photos and get reviews". This one is built for Delhi NCR: crowded markets where ten shops share one building, sector-based addresses, Hindi and Hinglish searches, and customers who would rather send a WhatsApp message than fill in a form. Work through it in order. Google's own rules come first, because a suspended profile ranks nowhere.

sections.h2: How Google picks the Delhi map pack
sections.html:
Google says local results depend mainly on three things: relevance (how well your profile matches the search), distance (how far you are from the searcher or the area they named) and prominence (how well known you are, including reviews and mentions across the web). You can't move your shop closer to every customer, so the work is on relevance and prominence.

Distance matters a lot in Delhi. A clinic in Dwarka Sector 12 often won't show for someone searching from Janakpuri, even with better reviews. So the realistic goal is to win the searches in your own area and nearby sectors or colonies, then use ads to reach further. That's also why one strong profile per real branch beats one profile trying to cover all of Delhi NCR.

sections.h2: Get the basics right before anything else
sections.html:
FieldWhat to doCommon Delhi mistake
Business nameExactly what is on your signboard and billsAdding "Best IELTS Coaching in Dwarka" to the name. Google's guidelines don't allow keywords in the name and it can get the profile suspended
Primary categoryThe most specific one that describes what you are, such as "Dental clinic" rather than "Clinic"Picking a broad category, or one for a service you only offer occasionally
Secondary categoriesA few that cover your other real servicesAdding ten categories as keywords
Address and pinFull address with block, sector or pocket, floor, and pin code. Drag the map pin to your actual entrancePin dropped on the main road while the shop is in a lane behind it
Service areaOnly if you visit customers. Hide the address if customers never come to youListing a home address as a storefront, or a virtual office where nobody works
HoursReal customer-facing hours, plus special hours for Diwali, Holi and other closuresShowing "Open" on a holiday and getting angry reviews
PhoneA number someone actually answers during business hoursAn old number or the owner's personal phone that is always busy

Google's rules also say a co-working desk only qualifies if it has clear signage, your own staff are there during business hours and customers are received there. Rules change, so read the current Business Profile guidelines before you edit a name, address or category.

sections.h2: Write the profile the way Delhi customers search
sections.html:
Relevance comes from the words on your profile, your website and your reviews. Put them where Google allows:

  • Description (up to 750 characters): say what you do, who it's for and which areas you serve in plain sentences. Mention nearby landmarks people use, such as the closest metro station or market. No links, no phone numbers, no keyword lists.
  • Services and products: list each real service with a short description and, where it helps, a starting price in ₹. A salon might list bridal makeup, keratin and hair spa separately instead of one "salon services" line.
  • Attributes: tick the ones that are true, such as a wheelchair-accessible entrance or online appointments. They show on the profile and help with filtered searches.
  • Hinglish and Hindi: many people search in Hinglish ("sasta solar panel Delhi", "bachon ka doctor Dwarka"). You can't stuff these into the profile, but you can use the plain Hindi word for your service in the description and in replies to reviews, where it reads naturally.

sections.h2: Photos, videos and posts that earn the click
sections.html:
Your photos decide whether people tap you or the listing below. In Delhi, the most useful photo is often the one that helps a customer find you: the building from the road, the gate, the floor board in the lift lobby and the shop front. Then add:

  1. Five to ten real photos of the inside, the team and the work itself (no stock images).
  2. A short phone video walking from the main road to your door. It reduces "where are you exactly?" calls.
  3. Fresh photos every month, especially before your busy season: admissions for coaching centres, wedding season for salons, summer for solar installers.

Google Posts (updates, offers and events) won't push you to the top on their own, and Google has never said they improve rankings. They do give people who already found you a reason to call now. Post an offer or update every week or two, with one clear button.

sections.h2: Reviews: the part you can't skip
sections.html:
Reviews feed prominence and they are the first thing customers read. What helps most is a steady flow of recent reviews that mention the service and the area naturally, plus a reply from you on every single one, good or bad.

The simplest system is a direct review link sent on WhatsApp right after the job is done, and a QR card at the counter. We've written the full method, with message templates, in how to get more Google reviews. Two warnings: never buy reviews or offer discounts in exchange for them, and don't ask staff to collect reviews from their own friends. Google has tightened its spam detection and can remove reviews or restrict a profile when it spots unusual patterns.

sections.h2: Turn profile views into calls and WhatsApp chats
sections.html:
Ranking is only half the job. Check what happens when someone taps your listing:

  • Website link: send people to the page for that location or service, not just the homepage. Add a UTM tag (for example ?utm_source=google&utm_medium=gbp) so you can see these visits separately in Google Analytics.
  • Chat and WhatsApp: Google's old built-in chat was switched off in 2024. In many regions you can now add a WhatsApp click-to-chat link under Contact. If the option shows for you, use it, and set up an instant auto-reply so nobody waits. Our WhatsApp marketing guide covers the follow-up flow.
  • Booking: clinics, salons and gyms should link an appointment page or booking tool so people can book without calling.
  • Questions: Google has been phasing out the public Q&A section, so answer common questions (fees, parking, timings, home visits) in your description, services and website FAQ instead.

sections.h2: Citations, branches and keeping it clean
sections.html:
Prominence also comes from your name, address and phone number appearing the same way across the web. In India that means Justdial, Sulekha, IndiaMART for B2B, Practo for doctors, Zomato and Swiggy for food, plus your Facebook and Instagram pages and your own website footer. One old phone number on Justdial can confuse customers for years, so clean these up once.

If you have branches, say in Dwarka and Gurugram, each staffed location gets its own profile with the same brand name, its own phone number and its own location page on your website. Never create extra profiles for the same shop to cover more areas. That is one of the fastest ways to get every profile suspended.

Finally, protect what you've built. Keep two owners on the profile (never only the agency), check the profile every week for suggested edits from the public, and keep your signboard, invoices and a utility bill handy in case Google asks for re-verification. Video verification usually means one continuous recording that shows the street, your signage, the workspace and proof that you manage the place.

sections.h2: A 30-day Google Business Profile optimisation plan
sections.html:
1. Week 1: fix name, categories, address pin, hours and phone. Remove duplicate listings.
  2. Week 2: write the description, add every service with prices, tick attributes, upload 15 or more real photos and a direction video.
  3. Week 3: start the WhatsApp review request routine and reply to every old review. Update your Justdial and other listings to match.
  4. Week 4: add the UTM-tagged website link, publish your first offer post, and note your starting numbers from the Performance tab: calls, direction requests, website clicks and the search terms people used.

Then review those numbers each month. Map pack positions usually move over weeks to months, not days, and nobody can promise a top-three spot. faqs: How do I get my business into the Google Maps top 3 in Delhi?

Use your real business name, the most specific primary category, an accurate map pin and full hours. Then fill every section with real photos and services, collect recent reviews steadily and reply to all of them, and keep your name, address and phone the same on Justdial and other sites. Distance still matters, so focus on winning searches near your location.
Can I add keywords like 'best' or my area to my Google Business Profile name?

No. Google's guidelines say the name must match your real-world name on your signboard and bills. Adding keywords, locations or taglines can lead to suspension. Use the description, services and your website for those words instead.
How long does Google Business Profile optimisation take to show results?

Fixes like the right category or a corrected pin can change what you show for within a few weeks. Gains from reviews and citations build over two to six months. Track calls, direction requests and website clicks in the Performance tab to see progress.
Can I list my business on Google without a shop in Delhi?

Yes, if you visit customers at their location. Set it up as a service-area business, hide your address and list the areas you serve. A virtual office or a mailing address where you don't work isn't eligible.
Yes. Creating and managing a Google Business Profile is free. You only pay if you choose to run Google Ads or hire someone to manage it for you.
